solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Fish for each companion

parts.note: per means for each, as in 'a pound per person'
CH is the abbreviation for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: An angler names a fish that goes with each of his companions.
explanation.definitionFit: The perch is a common freshwater fish, so it is an example of the general word.

clue.text: Official in favour of jailbird smugly offering the odds

parts.note: pro means in favour of, as in pros and cons
a con is a convict, someone in jail

indicators.note: the odds are the letters in the odd-numbered places of the next word, first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: A bureaucrat who backs a prisoner smugly quotes betting odds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'offering the odds' looks like bookmaking, but it picks letters 1, 3 and 5 of 'smugly', giving SUL.
explanation.definitionFit: A proconsul was a Roman provincial governor, and the word now means a colonial administrator, a kind of official.

clue.text: Almost an island this island state

indicators.note: almost means the word is not quite complete, its last letter dropped

parts.note: Rhodes is a Greek island in the Aegean

explanation.surface: A riddle about which island state is nearly a famous island.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue leans on the word 'island' twice: the answer with 'Island' after it is the smallest US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhode Island is a US state, so the first word of its name is what 'this island state' points to.

clue.text: The pale shimmering last drop

indicators.note: shimmering suggests something wavering and unsettled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pale liquid glimmers in the bottom of a glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A heeltap is the dregs of liquor left in the bottom of a glass, the last drop.

clue.text: Persuade that underwear is being laundered

parts.note: a bra is an item of women's underwear
clothes being laundered are in the wash

explanation.surface: Someone argues that a piece of underwear is being laundered.
explanation.definitionFit: To brainwash is to persuade someone forcefully until they adopt your beliefs.

clue.text: Bachelor had game although very drunk

parts.note: lotto is a game of chance like bingo

explanation.surface: A single man played a game despite being thoroughly drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Blotto is informal slang meaning extremely drunk.

clue.text: Porter's home from pub

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, a kind of ale
a house is a home

explanation.surface: A hotel porter makes his way home from the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Porter' looks like a man carrying bags; it is the beer.
explanation.definitionFit: An alehouse is an old word for a pub or tavern.

clue.text: One would not care to be guilty of it

definitions.text: One would not care to be guilty of it

parts.words: One would not care to be guilty of it
parts.note: reads as a fault nobody wants to admit, but literally it is the failing of not caring for something

explanation.surface: Nobody would want to be accused of this fault.
explanation.definitionFit: Neglect is the failure to care for something, so a person guilty of it does not care.

clue.text: A bit intended, as mentioned, to make room

parts.note: a part is a bit of something

indicators.note: as mentioned signals that the word for intended is spoken, giving letters that sound the same

parts.note: intended means meant

explanation.surface: A small part was intended to make space.
explanation.definitionFit: An apartment can mean a single room or set of rooms, so it stands for a room.

clue.text: 51 in wizard spiral

indicators.note: in places the roman numeral inside the word for wizard

parts.note: a hex is a spell, and in Pennsylvania Dutch a witch or wizard
LI is 51 in roman numerals, L being 50 and I one

explanation.surface: A number appears inside a wizard's spiral.
explanation.definitionFit: A helix is a spiral shape, like a coil or corkscrew.

clue.text: Round area complete, say, but there's an airy gap!

parts.note: O is round in shape
a zone is an area

indicators.note: say signals that the word for complete is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: whole means complete

explanation.surface: A rounded region looks complete, except for a gap in the air.
explanation.definitionFit: The ozone hole is a thinning of the ozone layer in the upper atmosphere, a gap in the air.

clue.text: Bowl a girl redesigned

indicators.note: redesigned means made in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl remodels a bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: The Holy Grail was the cup or bowl of Arthurian legend, used at the Last Supper.

clue.text: Bird to be cooked, willow-warbler perhaps

parts.note: food to be cooked goes in the oven
a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A small bird is going in the oven, maybe a warbler.
explanation.walkthrough: Oven-tit is an old country name for the willow-warbler, from its domed, oven-shaped nest.
explanation.definitionFit: The willow-warbler is one bird known as the oven-tit, so 'perhaps' marks it as an example.

clue.text: Way to exhaust the economy?

parts.note: reads as a way of draining an economy, and a government drains it by demanding too much from taxpayers

explanation.surface: A question about how to wreck the national economy.
explanation.definitionFit: To overtax is both to tax too heavily and to strain or exhaust something.

clue.text: Very wet member in authority

indicators.note: in places the member inside the word for authority

parts.note: sway means power or authority, as in holding sway
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A soaked politician holds a position of power.
explanation.definitionFit: Swampy ground is marshy and waterlogged, very wet.

clue.text: Does it fly under water or skid on the road?

definitions.meaning: a board towed over water by a speedboat, a kind of plane for water
of a car, to slide on a film of water on the road surface

explanation.definitionFit: An aquaplane is a board towed on water, and to aquaplane is for tyres to skid on a wet road.

clue.text: In a kind of way one was found in fancy sweater

indicators.note: was found in places the numeral for one inside the jumbled word
fancy means elaborate or imagined, so the word's letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone discovers they were found inside a fancy sweater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' turns SWEATER into ASTWERE, and 'was found in' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: As it were is a phrase softening a statement, meaning in a manner of speaking.

clue.text: Teased Ray about time in April this year

indicators.note: about means around and in disorder, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone teased Ray about something in April.
explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle appeared in 2010, when the Christian festival fell on 4 April.
explanation.definitionFit: In 2010 the Sunday celebrating the Resurrection fell on 4 April, a particular day that spring.

clue.text: Left-winger going round on my behalf is in better shape

indicators.note: going round places the left-winger around the phrase for on my behalf

parts.note: a Red is a communist or socialist, a left-winger
on my behalf means for me

explanation.surface: A socialist acting for me has improved himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone reformed has improved their character or ways, so is in better shape.

clue.text: Slaughterman contained his amusement

indicators.note: contained means the letters sit inside the longer word

explanation.surface: A slaughterman held back his amusement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contained his' suggests restraint; 'contained' signals the answer sits inside 'Slaughterman', and 'his' links it to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Laughter is the sound of amusement, so the two are closely related.

clue.text: 50% of the time

parts.note: reads as half the time, and is also a time of day: thirty minutes past the hour of one

explanation.surface: Something happens half the time.
explanation.definitionFit: Half-one is British informal for half past one, a time, and literally half of one.

clue.text: Shakespearean does not quite go back in vehicle

indicators.note: in puts the reversed short word inside the vehicle

parts.note: a bus is a vehicle

indicators.note: back means the shortened word is read from right to left
does not quite means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: a turn is a go, as in it's your turn

explanation.surface: A Shakespearean actor can't quite get back on the bus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'does not quite go back' reads as hesitation, but it trims and turns a word for a go, and 'in vehicle' houses the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Brutus is a character in Shakespeare's Julius Caesar, one of Caesar's assassins.

clue.text: Nearly all the soldiers diet

indicators.note: nearly all means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a regiment is a body of soldiers

explanation.surface: Almost every soldier is on a diet.
explanation.definitionFit: A regimen is a prescribed plan of diet and exercise.

clue.text: Jay at home before ten with Edwin had been beset with bad luck

parts.note: J is the letter called jay
in means at home, as in staying in
X is the roman numeral for ten
Ed is a short form of Edwin

explanation.surface: Jay stayed home before Ten and Edwin arrived, and had suffered misfortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jay' looks like a bird or a name; it is the spelling of the letter J.
explanation.definitionFit: Jinxed means cursed, dogged by bad luck.

clue.text: Manager's one of the band, one played quietly inside

indicators.note: inside places the two letters within the instrument

parts.note: a cello is one of the instruments in a band or orchestra
A means one, as in a single thing
P is piano, the musical direction to play quietly

explanation.surface: A football manager is a band member, playing softly.
explanation.walkthrough: Fabio Capello was England football manager when this appeared; 'Manager's' is the definition plus 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabio Capello was the Italian manager of the England football team from 2008 to 2012.

clue.text: One getting into vehicle with nothing on in the capital

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed below, so the zero comes after
getting into puts the numeral inside the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
I is the roman numeral for one
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone gets into a car with no clothes on in the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with nothing on' suggests nakedness; it adds O after CAIR in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: Cairo is the capital city of Egypt.

clue.text: Thankless person favoured fireplace

parts.note: in means favoured or in fashion, as in in with the boss
a grate is the metal frame in a fireplace, standing for the fireplace

explanation.surface: An ungrateful person liked having a fireplace.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingrate is an ungrateful person.

clue.text: Priest losing his head, it's a crime

indicators.note: losing his head means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a parson is a parish priest

explanation.surface: A priest goes mad, and that is a crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Arson, deliberately setting fire to property, is a crime.

clue.text: I am putting silver ball behind insect

parts.note: I am contracts to I'm
AG is the chemical symbol for silver
O is ball-shaped

explanation.surface: I'm setting a silver ball behind an insect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'putting ... behind' only says the silver and ball come after I'M.
explanation.definitionFit: An imago is the final, adult stage of an insect.

clue.text: Made the most of general principle on other side

parts.note: a maxim is a general principle or rule

indicators.note: other suggests a different form, so the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone exploited a principle on the opposite side.
explanation.definitionFit: To maximise something is to make the most of it.

clue.text: Golf event finished allowing for future changes

parts.note: the Open is a major golf championship
ended means finished

explanation.surface: A golf tournament ended, leaving room for future changes.
explanation.definitionFit: Something open-ended has no fixed limit and can be changed or extended later.

clue.text: Simpleton I name in northern New York

indicators.note: in places I and the abbreviation for name inside the northern abbreviations

explanation.surface: A fool introduces himself in northern New York.
explanation.definitionFit: A ninny is a foolish person, a simpleton.
